title: Pensive Portrait
coreRelationships: The man's face and hand are the central focus, occupying the majority of the frame.
Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting creates strong contrast between illuminated and shadowed areas of the face.
The man's upward gaze directs the viewer's eye towards the upper right corner of the frame.
The texture of the beard and the subtle grain of the image contribute to a raw, authentic feel.
reuseFormula: Recreate a close-up, high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a subject with a thoughtful expression, using dramatic lighting to emphasize features and create deep shadows. Ensure a dark, clear area at the top for minimalist text. Overlay a small, light-weight, all-caps, loosely tracked sans-serif text in a desaturated color that matches the image's highlights, positioned centrally at the top.
